content:
kayla: tiny life update — two very different but delightful things: accepted an internal promotion to Staff PM today 🎉 and today is my 6-year anniversary with my partner so we had a mini backyard thing this morning 🥂. Id love to share with you all.
tom: holy wow congrats on both!! staff pm!!!!!! and anniversary? pics pls 😭❤️
jules: double congrats kayla!!! we should do a tiny office serenade/cheers — I can bring a mini bluetooth speaker and my ukulele (yes i own one) 🎶
amir: congrats!! poll: Friday 4pm for a quick 20-min "Kayla: Promo + Anniversary" drop-by? React with ✅ for yes / ❌ for no.
jen ny: (oops small typo in display name) — congrats kayla!!! i vote ✅ and cupcakes 🧁
people-ops-bot: Congrats Kayla! :tada: People Ops can book a 20-min slot and order cupcakes or sparkling cider. React with :handshake: if you'd like People Ops to coordinate.
kayla: Friday 2026-11-12 at 16:00 PT works for me. small things only — honestly just want to see faces. also jules: ukulele is a must.
tom: i will make a tiny banner that says "6 years + 1 promotion" (insufferable pun included)
jules: yes banner and ukulele. ill practice a 45-second song.
amir: RSVP link: https://tinyurl.com/kayla-cheers (placeholder)
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Redwood gift policy applies. If you'd like People Ops to arrange a team card, react with :handshake:.
jenny: :handshake:
tom: :thumbsup:
kayla: you folks are the best. im feeling very lucky. thanks for the love — snacks and ukulele welcome 🙏
